capabilities: Analyze the vault with local embeddings and community detection (Louvain)
Propose index notes with names, confidence scores and multi-index memberships
Review proposals by renaming, merging, splitting, ignoring or moving notes
Apply the index structure with frontmatter keys and links, and undo applies from a journal
Suggest indexes for new or edited notes incrementally after the first apply
disambiguation: Not a search tool; it builds topic-based index notes that link related notes, it does not query note content.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13+). Early 0.0.x version; the author advises trying it on a copy of the vault first. Downloads a ~130 MB embedding model once; all analysis runs locally with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to group notes by meaning automatically, so organizing a large vault's structure is manual work.

relations.evidence: The plugin makes exactly one kind of network request: downloading the embedding model

summary: Semantic organizer that runs local embedding models to cluster notes by meaning and propose index notes linking them.
